instruction: A candid portrait photograph in close-up shot showing two women indoors against a plain light grey wall. On the left, the woman with dark curly hair (R1) in a dusty pink velvet jacket turns her body away and looks back over her shoulder at the camera with a subtle smile. On the right, the woman with straight brown hair (R3) in a blue and orange striped shirt leans her head back against R1's head, looking upwards with a gentle smile. They are positioned back-to-back with their heads touching. Soft natural side lighting illuminates the scene, creating a warm, intimate mood.
